authority: Human Window27 limited frozen-prediction sensitivity authorization
base_support: Only W24 exploratory-eligible samples; no additions or altered labels/features/scores
feature_lookback: W24 previous shared market session and signal session; all raw OHLC must be finite, positive and consistent; no fill
endpoints: Entry open and exit close required finite positive; missing record distinct from zero/invalid value
holding_path: Every shared market session from entry through exit inclusive requires finite positive consistent OHLC; no stock-row compression, fill or rolling
known_unit_event: Exclude if previous_feature_session < effective_market_date <= signal OR entry < effective_market_date <= exit; current verified event only 2321 2023-02-17; no new events inferred by return size
event_evidence: research/v7/window26-event-matrix.json; 2022 accounting date is not market effective date
unknown_risk: Retain incomplete action/suspension/availability/vintage coverage as UNKNOWN on every sample, including eligible development proxies; not CLEAN, PIT or executable evidence
temporal: Assert unchanged W24 signal/entry/exit shared-session geometry, feature dependencies at/before signal, exit strictly before next split, dataset/label hash and original prediction identity; invalid source geometry stops analysis
maturity: Logical exit-close maturity before each original split cutoff; current retrieval archive after exits; actual historical publication remains UNKNOWN under limited retrospective scope
counts: All reason flags plus exactly one first-priority primary reason per excluded sample; primary totals disjoint; UNKNOWN risk is not an extra exclusion
training: Report safety mask on TRAIN for diagnostics only; frozen fitted state remains unchanged and retained training contamination cannot be undone by evaluation filtering
common_support: Intersect each model with identical policy-eligible security/session/horizon keys; require identical original label identity/value; never order-match
daily_universe: Evaluate all original daily groups including groups emptied by filtering; preserve empty/insufficient reasons and old/new key difference ledger
comparison: Read old stored metrics; calculate new metrics only on common filtered support with W25 paired helper/W08 primitive; report original means plus old means on jointly defined dates; do not claim superiority
